ratios.covenant_name: maximum consolidated net leverage ratio of total indebtedness to EBITDA
ratios.quote: (ii) in the case of the Amended 57 Table o f Contents Revolving Credit Facility, the 5.38 % Senior Notes and 5.49 % Senior Notes, a maximum consolidated net leverage ratio of total indebtedness to EBITDA (earnings before interest expense, taxes, depreciation, amortization and stock-based compensation) of no more than 3.50 to 1.00 (or, at the election of the Company after it consummates a material acquisition, a four-quarter temporary increase to 4.00 to 1.00)

ratios.covenant_name: minimum consolidated interest coverage ratio of EBITDA to total interest expense
ratios.quote: (iii) in the case of both the Private Placement Debt and the Amended Revolving Credit Facility, a minimum consolidated interest coverage ratio of EBITDA to total interest expense of at least 3.00 to 1.00.

parsed.notes: The filing does not disclose actual ratio values. It states only that the Company was in compliance as of August 29, 2026. The net leverage limit can be temporarily raised to 4.00x for four quarters after a material acquisition, at the Company's election. The 3.00x maximum consolidated leverage ratio is excluded because it applies only to the 2.60% and 5.73% Senior Notes, which are private placement notes and not the bank facility. The net leverage ratio is also used to set the interest rate spread on the revolver, but it is reported here only as a covenant.
